beaches.name: KAPE nudist cove (Legrena)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is the usual use of the small cove beside KAPE beach. A May 2026 state shore-concession decision for film shooting names the cove 'παραλία Γυμνιστών ΚΑΠΕ' and gives its coordinates; it sets no dress rule and no designation is documented. Local and national press (2016, 2024, 2025) describe the cove reached past the KAPE stairs as a nudist beach separate from the main KAPE beach.

beaches.name: Legrena second beach (KAPE)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on a small pebble beach 130 m NNW of the KAPE nudist cove. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2017 and 2020, with men nude and most women topless or nude; it is reached directly from the KAPE parking lot.

beaches.name: Porto Germeno (second beach)
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix on a secluded pebble beach near Porto Germeno. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2019, 2020 and 2022, with half to most bathers nude and free camping at one end; no newer report is documented.

beaches.name: Ramnous (Ramnounta) coves
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported in the pebble coves below the Ramnous archaeological site. A naturist directory carries consistent visitor reports from 2012 to 2020; Greek press listicles from 2024 and 2025 repeat the claim. The coves lie past two swimwear beaches, a 10-minute walk from the Agia Marina church parking.

beaches.name: Schinias
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported off-season on the forest-backed middle and northeast rocks. A naturist directory carries reports that naturist use faded by 2014-2015 and resumed from 2019, with a 2023 report of many nude couples on off-peak weekends. The sandy stretch is swimwear in season.

beaches.name: Vravrona rocks
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at two rocky spots on a peninsula past Vravrona. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2017 and 2020 describing a regular community said to have used the place for about 30 years; no report newer than 2020 is documented. There is no beach, only rocks and steps to the sea.

beaches.name: Kineta (east end)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported east of the main beach, past rocks beyond the hotel. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2020 and 2022; a 2024 Greek press listicle also names Kineta. The nude section is a 5-10 minute walk over big rocks; no designation is documented.

beaches.name: Marikes, Rafina
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported in a rocky cove beyond the right-hand end of the beach. A naturist directory carries one undated visitor report of about 80% nude use; Greek press listicles from 2024 and 2025 also name Marikes. Houses overlook the cliff top; no designation is documented.

beaches.name: Agios Nikolaos, Anavyssos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported across a small pebble cove 4.5 km southeast of Saronida. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2017 to 2023 describing the beach as fully nudist; Greek press listicles from 2024 and 2025 call it a cove exclusively for nudists. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Althea hotel beach (Mavro Lithari)
beaches.summary: Reports of nude bathing at this beach below an abandoned hotel conflict. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2017 to 2023: nudist-friendly through 2022, but a June 2023 report finds almost no nudists among textile bathers; hotel building works restarted in 2020 and stopped by 2022. A Greek press article names the adjacent Mavro Lithari area as a nudist alternative.

beaches.name: Limanakia (B' Limanaki), Vouliagmeni
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is established in two rocky coves between Vouliagmeni and Varkiza. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from the 2000s to 2022; Greek press listicles from 2024 and 2025 also name B' Limanakia. Reports describe a largely gay male crowd; no designation or signage is documented.
